title: Fill compiled-routine verify poll on binary B7: stamped causal A/B (P10a/P10b/P1/P0/PC) plus scripted BASE vs composed S on one binary
lineage: B-08 Part E: fill's last untested component 'runner' (9.82 ms = 14.5% of mean T_runner, C arm, corrected view, B7), post-hoc unmarked verify poll 10.23 ms per C trial (B-08 Deviation 4)

advances.E2: a terminal verdict (DELETED or IRREDUCIBLE) for the compiled routine's verify-poll sleep on fill, with the poll stamped; fill's untested share of mean T_runner recomputed on B7 (B-08: 16.9% / 19.0%), target < 5%
advances.E3: paired scripted BASE vs composed fill (including this poll verdict) S on the same binary B7, 36 pairs
advances.E4: counters in every arm; the live fill configuration's warm path is covered because compiled replay plus guarded completion on fill makes 0 provider decisions (R2-03), so the chooser is never called inside T

amendments: none permitted: PREREG.json is never amended; any deviation is a disclosed post-hoc reading

hypothesis.H_P: fill's 'runner' component on B7 is the caller-side compiled routine's verify-poll sleep (bounded_read interval_s=0.010 in harness/b04/harness/compiled_routine.py, B-08 copy), which runs after the first verify read finds the effect not yet visible. Cutting the interval to 1 ms deletes >= 3 ms of median T_runner per fill task with identical verified outcomes. What remains of the wait is target-effect latency (submit dispatch return -> server journal commit), which is IRREDUCIBLE
hypothesis.scope: caller runner configuration, not a Driver change; B7 is unchanged

source.tested_sha_note: R' 45dff8f32 + B-05 marks + the default-off POST_FAST knob (B-07); libs/cua-driver Linux tree = upstream 0f1955d2f
source.build: none; nothing is built in this lane

binary.name: cua-driver-b07-231f6e8bb
binary.rule: re-hashed on the host and inside the session at lane start and end; the runner refuses on a sha256 mismatch and writes name, sha256 and version into every trial record, every control (SMOKE, N-W2) record and every chunk manifest

harness.first_commit: exp(b-09): copy B-08 harness and lane code blob-identical from 49ae94590

changed.harness/b04/harness/compiled_routine.py: one reviewed commit before this PREREG: CUA_LANE_EXP_ROUTINE_POLL_MS sets the verify bounded_read interval (unset = 10 ms = current behaviour; 0 = await asyncio.sleep(0), a yield only; reconcile reads unaffected); STAMP hook (None by default) records routine_read_send / routine_read_return around each routine oracle read and poll_sleep_start / poll_sleep_end around each poll sleep (time.monotonic_ns)

harness.unchanged_rule: every other harness file keeps its B-08 blob id (provenance.json; verify_artifacts.py checks)
harness.unit_evidence: tests/test_b09_poll.py + tests/test_compiled_routine_r207.py (R2-07 suite, blob e9c7ff81e from 2d71548b4): raw/unit/unit-red.log (new tests against the unmodified routine: 9 errors, 6 skipped) and raw/unit/unit-green.log (32/32 OK)
harness.pilot: 12 trials (plan pilot, rounds 0-1 of the measured square, SHARED lock b09-pilot-r00-01, load rule off with --load-max 100, 1-min loadavg 11-12) ran before this PREREG to check the receipts and the pipeline; excluded from every analysis; it set no gate, threshold or rule

configuration.forced_path_every_arm_except_BASE: R2-10 scripted COMP fill exactly as B-08 C: feedback off, focus settle 0, caller-compiled output validators, CUA_DRIVER_EXP_ADMISSION_TOOLS_CACHE=1, guarded completion + compiled replay (R2-10R scripted COMP artifact, routine verify deadline 2.0 s), phase trace on with the B-05/B-07 marks, B-07 stamped stdio client (default variant), scripted chooser, telemetry false, no provider key forwarded
configuration.BASE: R2-10 BASE = B-04 run_b04 'DEFAULT' config: feedback on, default glide, no guard, 100 ms poll, library validators, no CUA_DRIVER_EXP_*, step loop; phase trace on (as B-08 SMOKE); used for S only
configuration.per_trial: fresh cua-driver mcp, fresh Driver-launched system Chrome (isolated_new, sandbox on), fresh fixture servers, token and session label; every trial cold (the task document is the process's first)
configuration.lane_variables: set in the runner process for the trial only; the Driver environment never carries CUA_LANE_EXP_* (asserted per trial and recorded)

arms.P10b: identical to P10a, second label (A/A negative control)
arms.PC: P10a + CUA_LANE_EXP_PC_SLEEP_MS=15: a 15.0 ms CLOCK_MONOTONIC sleep inside T right after snapshot1 returns (as B-08 P2); measured per trial
arms.SMOKE: after the measured rounds: product default (B-04 DEFAULT, no CUA_DRIVER_EXP_*, no lane variable), 5 trials, correctness only
arms.NW2: after the measured rounds: FIX-01 N-W2 detached-node refusal (B-02 run_b02.control_one unchanged, COMP admission knob), 3 trials
arms.not_run: toggle / modal (their runner gap is 0.13-0.15 ms in B-08 Part E)

design.square: 6x6 Williams square rc.williams(6) (rows [0,1,5,2,4,3] + i mod 6; index 0=BASE,1=P10a,2=P10b,3=P1,4=P0,5=PC); round r runs row r mod 6
design.rounds: 36 rounds (rounds 0-35) = 6 squares; every contrast has 36 pairs; 216 measured trials
design.controls: plan ctl after round 35 (round index 36): 5 SMOKE then 3 N-W2
design.session: 0-3 s random start jitter before each private Xvfb session and an xdpyinfo probe before any trial
design.chunks: each measured chunk = one EXCLUSIVE bin/quiet-timed acquisition (label b09-<chunk>) taken only after the cargo-build lock was seen free; inside it the cargo-build lock taken with flock -w 60 (not acquired: exit 74, nothing runs, retry later); timeout 900 around everything inside; the runner starts no round past a 780 s budget; up to 12 rounds per chunk
design.round_attempts: a round is atomic for the load rule. If a round is cut its trials are kept in raw/ and reported, and the round index is re-run with attempt+1. For each round the analysis uses the first attempt listed as completed in its chunk manifest; failed trials stay in the denominators. Trials of cut attempts are counted separately

load_rule.rule: a round starts only when the 1-min loadavg is <= 4.0; the runner polls every 1 s for up to 60 s; if still > 4.0 it ends the chunk (exit 75), both locks are released, and the same round index resumes later
load_rule.logging: every load check is in the chunk manifest; loadavg before/after is in every trial record; every trial is kept
load_rule.sensitivity: descriptive view of NC / PC / POLL without rounds containing a trial with loadavg_before > 4.0

oracle.owner: target-owned, independent of the Driver: the jev-use fixture server state (submitted == token) and its CLOCK_MONOTONIC journal, which must show exactly one completion (submit) mutation
oracle.PRIMARY_T_runner: snapshot1 call_send -> return of the first verified oracle read (R2-10's T, the one B-08 Part E decomposes)
oracle.SECONDARY: T_j (B-08 definition: max(journal completion ts, caller return of the last accepted mutation) - task_start) and T_oracle (2 ms independent sampler, B-04 rule); reported, not gated
oracle.per_trial_accounting: after the last accepted mutation returns: reads count (oracle reads up to and including the verified one), sleeps count and summed poll sleep (stamped pairs), effect latency = journal completion ts - submit dispatch return (may be negative)

validity: b04_rows.row core (verified outcome, exact oracle match, T_oracle present, no revert after ok, exactly 1 completion mutation, no stale dispatch, expected action routes trusted_input + dom, configuration receipts of the arm's config) with the telemetry receipt 'false', AND the arm's config, AND T_runner and T_j defined, AND Driver pid + Chrome pid alive before the task navigate, AND Driver name / sha256 / version equal this PREREG, AND caller variant default, AND lane receipts (lane_env equals the arm's values, no CUA_LANE_EXP_* in the Driver environment, the routine's verify interval and every stamped sleep interval equal the arm's value), AND (PC: the sleep was measured), AND every E4 counter 0. Invalid trials stay in every denominator

e4.definitions: as B-08 PREREG e4.definitions (b09_rows.e4_counts is b08_rows.e4_counts unchanged)
e4.refusals: refusals refused: N-W2 3/3 pass (stale action effect=refused, 0 detached effects, re-derived action verified with exactly one completion mutation)

statistics.pairing: paired within-round differences of the primary T_runner; a pair needs both trials valid
statistics.bootstrap: percentile bootstrap of the median, 10000 resamples, a fresh random.Random(20261003) for every contrast, 95% CI = [sorted[250], sorted[9749]]
statistics.S: S = median T_runner(BASE) / median T_runner(composed) over the paired rounds; percentile bootstrap over the pairs (resample round indices with replacement, ratio of the two medians), 10000 resamples, fresh random.Random(20261003), 95% CI

gates.G0_validity: >= 95% valid in every arm (BASE, P10a, P10b, P1, P0, PC; 36 each) AND identical verified outcomes (every valid trial verified with exactly one completion mutation; no measured trial refuted or with > 1 completion mutation)
gates.G1_NC: P10a - P10b: 95% CI contains 0 AND |median| <= 1.0 ms
gates.G3_E4: every E4 counter 0 in every arm (incl. SMOKE) AND N-W2 3/3 pass (refusals refused)

verdict_rules.computed_only_if: G0, G1, G2 and G3 pass; otherwise UNDECIDED naming the failed gate(s) (not terminal)
verdict_rules.DELETED: median (P10a - P1) >= 3.0 ms AND its CI lower bound > 0: KEEP; the verify-poll sleep is deleted by a 1 ms interval
verdict_rules.IRREDUCIBLE: CI upper bound of (P10a - P1) < 3.0 ms: KILL; the residual wait is re-attributed to target-effect latency
verdict_rules.UNDECIDED: otherwise; not terminal, stated as such
verdict_rules.P0: descriptive only: P10a - P0 and P1 - P0 and the reads P0 adds are reported as work added, never as a deletion

E3_S.composed_arm: P1 if the poll verdict is DELETED, else P10a
E3_S.floor_ratio: mean T_runner (corrected) of the composed arm / T_irreducible from Part E' (sum of the IRREDUCIBLE bucket; BELOW_GATE counted as IRREDUCIBLE and as UNTESTED); the cold excess inside observation (per-process OWNER_DECISION B-08 + per-document IRREDUCIBLE B-04, split not measured here) is reported both excluded from and included in T_irreducible
E3_S.secondary: S on T_j and T_oracle (reported, not gated)
E3_S.boundary: scripted chooser only; BASE and composed on the same binary B7, same environment, interleaved

disposition.KEEP: a terminal poll verdict (DELETED or IRREDUCIBLE) with G0-G3 passing, S CI lower > 1, SMOKE 5/5 verified with no CUA_DRIVER_EXP_*, no lane variable and 0 mcp.inner_validation_skipped marks, N-W2 3/3, E4 = 0

part_E_prime.class: BENCHMARK analysis of this lane's own P10a arm and of the best arm (P1 if DELETED, else P10a only), binary B7; nothing is added to or ratioed with another lane's or binary's numbers
part_E_prime.T: R2-10 T_runner per valid trial with phase trace; rows with B-05 coverage < 0.98 are excluded and counted
part_E_prime.decomposition: B-08 Part E (harness/b05/b05_spans.decompose_b05 with R2-10's classifier and the B-07 units; R2-10 e2_components consistency per trial)
part_E_prime.split_view: decompose_b05 on a copy of the event log in which poll_sleep_start / poll_sleep_end are presented as sleep_start / sleep_end (region sleep -> sleeps_polls, reported as poll_sleep) and routine_read_send / routine_read_return as decide_start / decided (region decision, reported as read_hop: the routine's asyncio.to_thread hop around each oracle read); compiled arms make no provider decision inside T, which the analyzer counts (real_decisions_in_T must be 0). The target-effect tail rule runs first and is unchanged, so poll-sleep time between the submit dispatch return and the journal commit stays target_effect_lag (effect_wait). Consistency: B-08's runner (no stamps) = poll_sleep + read_hop + runner_other per trial
part_E_prime.runner_split_reported: per arm and view: runner (B-08 labels), poll_sleep, read_hop, runner_other, target_effect_lag, effect_wait inside poll sleep (= summed poll sleep - poll_sleep), mean effect latency
part_E_prime.views: PRIMARY corrected at c_m = median of this lane's in-situ null-pair intervals over the valid P10a and best-arm trials; SECONDARY raw
part_E_prime.cold_excess: E = span(snapshot1) - span(snapshot2) per trial (b04_rows excess_b03_ms), mean per arm, inside observation; terminal (per-process OWNER_DECISION B-08, per-document IRREDUCIBLE B-04) but its split is not measured here (no warm arm), so it is its own bucket (COLD_EXCESS)
part_E_prime.untested_share: UNTESTED ms / mean T_runner (view) for P10a and the best arm, BELOW_GATE counted as IRREDUCIBLE and as UNTESTED; target < 5% in both BELOW_GATE views
part_E_prime.list: every component and every lane-scope unit with mean >= 5% of mean T or >= 50 ms, with verdict and source lane

target_effect_lag: R2-10 (effect_wait: submit dispatch return -> journal commit; H_P)
read_hop: B-09 (routine asyncio.to_thread hop around each oracle read; not tested)
runner_other: R2-10 / B-09 (rest of the runner gap)
admission tools-list cache: DELETED (already on: the deleted re-validation is not in T; receipt mcp.inner_validation_skipped)

c_in.prep: B-07 (PREP_FAST KILL on toggle/modal; fill's fragile DELETED is not carried)
res.frame_proof: B-07 (invariant: Page.getFrameTree re-proves the ref's frame identity)
res.editable_check: B-07 (invariant: non-editable targets refused before typing)

verdict_map.carry_check: the unit labels are B-08's PREREG part_E units (B-07 labels on the same binary B7; c_in.prep on fill UNTESTED by rule)

part_E_prime.never: no number is added to or ratioed across lanes or binaries; absolute T is never compared with B-06 / B-08 / R2-10R

descriptive: median / mean T_runner, T_j, T_oracle per arm
reads, sleeps, summed poll sleep and effect latency per arm

provider.provider: TypeSafe not used (scripted chooser); attempts and reached are reported (0 / 0)

claim_boundary: one shared Linux host, private Xvfb, Google Chrome as Driver-chosen, binary B7 only, scripted chooser. The poll is a caller runner setting; its jev-use product default (100 ms in run.py) is not changed, and any proposal to change that default is an OWNER_DECISION row, not this lane's claim. Absolute T is never compared with B-06 / B-08 / R2-10R
